# Final QA checklist

## Story coverage

- Every distinct idea in the source appears once.
- No frame combines unrelated claims.
- Exact excerpts remain in narrative order.
- Lists, examples, and contrasts are split when each item deserves its own visual.

## Prompt quality

- The visual claim states what the viewer should understand.
- Objects and relationships are concrete.
- The chosen visual mode matches the idea.
- The mascot has a purposeful role.
- The title and labels are quoted exactly.
- The full visual language and avoid list are present.

## Image quality

- The frame reads at thumbnail size.
- The title is legible and spelled correctly.
- No unintended pseudo-text appears.
- Arrows begin and end at meaningful objects.
- The mascot silhouette and orange color are consistent.
- The frame is 16:9 and has safe margins.
- Adjacent frames do not repeat the same composition excessively.

## Delivery

- The number of image files equals the number of beats.
- The manifest validator passes.
- The side-by-side review page loads every image.
- The review page and image folder are opened for the user.
